documents.title: Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 To Be Held On October 29, 2026.

Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, October 23, 2026 - Substitution Of Proposed Allottees And Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 Of D. P. Abhushan Limited
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Extra-Ordinary General Meeting (Eogm) Of Shareholders To Be Held On October 29, 2026

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with total revenue growing 58% year-on-year to INR 853.63 crores and net profit increasing by 77% to INR 64 crores. Management highlighted robust demand driven by summer weddings and festive occasions, alongside increasing traction in old-gold exchange transactions and the recently launched D.P. Swarn Plus Scheme. The company is actively pursuing physical expansion through both COCO and pilot FOCO models, alongside digital and omnichannel capability enhancements.

guidance.claim: Management targets around 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: D.P. Abhushan plans to expand its presence across Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, and Maharashtra over the next five years.
guidance.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

guidance.claim: The company aims to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30% by the end of 2030 in terms of top line.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5% by 2030.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue of INR 4,800 crores for FY27 and INR 5,500 crores for the next year.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margin guidance for FY27 is around 6% to 6.5%.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving growth of around 20% going forward in FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, we are confident of achieving growth of around 20% going forward, driven by strong wedding demand in the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer demand remained healthy across all operating markets during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across all our operating markets during the quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Jewellery buying gained traction after the gold price correction, supported by various promotional offerings.
demand_outlook.quote: While overall consumer demand remained somewhat subdued in June, industry feedback indicated that jewellery buying gained traction after the price correction, supported by exchange offers, promotional campaigns, and flexible payment options.

demand_outlook.claim: Footfall at stores was encouraging with a footfall-to-conversion ratio of 81%.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

demand_outlook.claim: Average ticket size during the quarter was approximately Rs. 1,57,000.
demand_outlook.quote: During the quarter, our average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000, supported by wedding-led purchases and festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand across the company's markets remained healthy during Q1 FY27, driven by both consumption and investment purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange contributed approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Gold jewellery demand remains resilient, especially in wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Even in periods of elevated gold prices, we continue to see jewellery demand remain resilient, especially in wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets like ours.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter designs such as daily-wear gold, studded jewellery, and minimalist designs.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter designs. Daily-wear gold, studded jewellery, and minimalist designs are gaining popularity This trend supports higher purchase frequency with lower ticket sizes.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality, with June and July typically seeing relatively lower demand after the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: That said, demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality. For instance, the wedding season has recently concluded, and months like June and July typically see relatively lower demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver demand remains intact and is growing as consumers shift towards it due to increasing gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver demand remains intact. In fact, with gold prices increasing and impacting demand, we are seeing a shift towards silver.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finalized locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod.
capex_expansion.quote: Under this roadmap, we have successfully finalized the locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahod showroom will be about 3,200 sq. ft. and operate under the COCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market. This showroom will operate under the Company-Owned Company-Operated model.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jabalpur showroom will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and operate under the FOCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second showroom, in Jabalpur, will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and will be our first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.

capex_expansion.claim: Management aims to reach a total of 51 stores by FY30.
capex_expansion.quote: Broadly, we are targeting around 10% volume growth going forward. Internally, our primary focus remains on volume growth, and we believe that achieving around 10% growth in volumes is a reasonable target.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated a new showroom in Dhar, taking the total showroom network to 12.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capex_expansion.claim: For the current year, the company has planned to open three to four new stores and one franchise store.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores. Additionally, we have already finalized one franchisee and will be opening one franchise store as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.
capex_expansion.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 increased by 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores.
margins_costs.quote: At operating level, EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR93.99 crores in Q1 '27 as compared to INR55 crores in Q1 '26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin expanded to 7.55%, up 82 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin expanded to 7.55%, up 82 basis points year-on-year, reflecting strong profitability growth and sustained efficiency across the businesses.

margins_costs.claim: For full year FY26, EBITDA margins improved to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for full year FY26 improved to 5.20%, an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at INR211.8 crores, delivering a robust growth of 88% YoY, with PAT margins improving to 5.20%, an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects gross margins to be maintained at approximately 10% to 11%.
margins_costs.quote: As far as gross margins are concerned, we expect the business to maintain approximately 10% to 11%.

margins_costs.claim: Adoption of Gold Metal Loans and hedging is going to help reduce the finance cost gradually.
margins_costs.quote: And definitely, the finance cost is going to gradually go down also.

orders_capacity.claim: Total retail store area stood at approximately 53,650 sq. ft. supporting growing scale of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Average revenue per sq. ft. was ~INR 7.6 lakhs and ~INR 339 crores per store for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: On the productivity front, we delivered an average revenue of ~INR7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR339 crores per store for FY26, reflecting strong store-level performance and efficient utilization of retail space.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall customer conversion rate has remained largely stable at ~82% to ~83%.
orders_capacity.quote: Our store-level conversion remains strong, with key stores such as Ratlam and Ratlam II delivering higher-than-average conversion levels, while overall conversion has remained largely stable at ~82%–83%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilizes Gold Metal Loans and hedging mechanisms to mitigate gold price volatility and preserve working capital efficiency.
capital_allocation.quote: Continue to follow a disciplined approach towards gold procurement and inventory management, exchange gold, leveraging Gold Metal Loans (GMLs) and hedging mechanisms at commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility while supporting margin stability and working capital efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: The planned QIP has been put on hold as market conditions are not favorable.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable. As a result, we have not proceeded with it yet.

capital_allocation.claim: Expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be executed through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

capital_allocation.claim: More than 90% to 95% of the company's investment is in inventory with no immediate need for long-term funding.
capital_allocation.quote: If you look at our balance sheet, more than 90% to 95% of our investment is in inventory. So, our capital requirement is largely driven by inventory, and there is no immediate need for long-term funding.

risks_headwinds.claim: The increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact, supported by India’s cultural affinity for gold, wedding and festive led demand, rising formalisation, omnichannel adoption.

risks_headwinds.claim: The government raised the import duty on gold and silver from approximately 6% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Government raised the import duty on gold (and silver) from ~6% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volume growth remained under pressure during FY26 due to high and volatile gold prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Throughout FY26, gold prices were on an upward trajectory and quite volatile, which impacted affordability and consumer buying patterns. As a result, while value growth remained strong, volume growth was relatively muted.

risks_headwinds.claim: Recent announcements by the Prime Minister and customs duty changes may have a short-term impact on consumer sentiment.
risks_headwinds.quote: While recent regulatory measures, government announcements, and elevated gold prices may influence short-term consumer sentiment, we remain confident in the underlying strength of the jewellery sector and our positioning within it.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets increasing the diamond studded ratio up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach a total of 51 stores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: So, by this way we will achieve this 51 which is our vision also.

management_commitments.claim: Management is targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

management_commitments.claim: D.P. Abhushan plans to expand its retail footprint into Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities across five states over the upcoming 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: Upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod are progressing through fit-out activities and are expected to become operational shortly.
management_commitments.quote: Fit-out and showroom development activities are progressing at both locations, and the stores are expected to become operational shortly.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach a total of around 51 stores by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: So, by 2030, we are planning to have a total of around 51 stores.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting Jaipur for store expansion in the next one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting EBITDA margins between 8% and 8.5% by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets digital omni-channel contribution of around 3% to 5% of topline revenue over the next three to five years.
management_commitments.quote: So, over the long term, in the next three to five years, we are targeting around 3% to 5% of our topline revenue to come from this segment.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
